title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range [0, Inf). max - min level whole slice. crudest measure much well moves. Inflated long-term trend — use seasonal_amplitude within-year signal.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range [0, Inf). Mean, calendar years, annual max - min. typical size yearly recharge–discharge swing, multi-decadal drift removed. Large shallow unconfined aquifers strong seasonal recharge regime; small deep confined systems.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range [0, 1]. max(0, 1 - var(remainder) / var(seasonal + remainder)) STL decomposition ([stats::stl()]) monthly-mean series (Wang, Smith & Hyndman 2006). 0 = detectable annual cycle (hydrograph trend- event-dominated, typical deep confined heads heavily abstracted systems); ~1 = dynamics almost purely annual cycle.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_recharge_months [1, 12], ind_discharge_months [0, 11] (sum 12). 12 climatological monthly means: number months annual trough annual peak (mean rising limb) complement 12. short recharge / long discharge limb system fills quickly winter rain drains slowly summer.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range [0, Inf) (circular SD, months). Circular standard deviation (months, Mardia & Jupp 2000) month year’s minimum falls. Near 0 = metronomic seasonal cycle (low always lands month); large = event-driven irregular timing, sign well responds individual storms rather seasonal balance.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range (0.5, 12.5] columns (circular months). Circular-mean month annual minimum annual maximum level (lap_circular_mean_month(); values (0.5, 12.5]). Together bracket discharge recharge periods locate well annual cycle — March maximum snowmelt-fed upland well, June maximum lowland well integrating spring rain.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range [1, Inf). sum(|diff(level)|) / (max - min) — total path length series travels per unit overall span (Baker et al. 2004, Richards–Baker index applied heads). High flashy shallow unconfined systems react every rain event; low (near 1) smooth, strongly filtered deep confined ones.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_acf1 [-1, 1], ind_memory_weeks [1, Inf). month-deseasonalised series: lag-1 autocorrelation first lag autocorrelation falls 1/e. internal persistence timescale — many weeks “memory” aquifer carries storage. Long memory (many months) means recharge integrated slowly: deep confined system, one thick unsaturated zone. See note timescales .

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_rise_rate, ind_fall_rate (0, Inf). Median magnitude positive negative step--step changes. large rise rate small fall rate system driven sharp recharge pulses drain slowly — classic saw-tooth karst shallow-sand hydrograph.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_trend_slope (-Inf, Inf), ind_trend_p_value [0, 1], ind_trend_significant {FALSE, TRUE}. Theil–Sen slope (level units per year) plus Mann–Kendall test annual-mean series. raw long-term trend — mixes climate signal (wet/dry decades) human influence. lap_gw_trend() gives full table confidence intervals; climate_signal separates two drivers.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range (-Inf, Inf) columns. Theil–Sen slope series annual minima annual maxima. ind_trend_min_slope negative mean trend, drought floor dropping faster average level — low-water conditions deepening even mean looks stable.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_step_year calendar year (fixed range), ind_step_magnitude (-Inf, Inf), ind_step_p_value [0, 1]. Pettitt change-point (1979): single likely year abrupt shift annual mean, size (minus ) approximate significance. Captures post-drought regime shifts (2003, 2018–2019 Central Europe) onset abstraction.

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Range (-Inf, Inf). Theil–Sen slope second half record minus slope first half. Negative = accelerating decline (recent slope steeper); positive = recovering decelerating well.

what: D. Drought and low water (need a standardised index)
title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Add one first lap_normalise_gwl("sgi") pass value = gwl_norm. SGI (Standardised Groundwater Index, Bloomfield & Marchant 2013) non-parametric normal-scores transform applied per calendar month: within month values ranked mapped qnorm(rank / (n + 1)), giving deseasonalised, unit-variance index directly comparable across wells different dynamic ranges. drought event maximal run SGI < threshold (default -1), .e. run theory (Yevjevich 1967).

text: Ranges ind_drought_recovery_weeks, ind_drought_n_unrecovered [0, Inf). event, number timesteps SGI minimum forward first SGI >= 0: mean events recover, count events still unrecovered end slice. Long non-completing recovery fingerprint slow, storage-controlled system — Peterson, Saft & Peel (2021) show aquifers return pre-drought state .

title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: Ranges ind_recession_weeks (0, Inf), ind_recession_n_segments [0, Inf). Sustained falling segments (least min_len steps, tolerating single -step) identified; within , log(level - asymptote) regressed time e-folding time -1 / slope extracted. ind_recession_weeks median segments, ind_recession_n_segments many contributed. master-recession-curve decay constant (Posavec et al. 2006; Fiorillo 2014): short fast, well-drained unconfined systems, long (many months) slow, low-diffusivity confined ones. can lengthen record storage depleted.

what: A note on the three timescales
title: Time-series indicators: what they mean
text: memory, climate_signal’s response time, recession describe “slow” well , number read together: ind_memory_weeks — internal autocorrelation. long perturbation persists well’s record, driver-agnostic. ind_response_months — external cross-correlation lag. long climate forcing takes reach well (unsaturated-zone travel + aquifer filtering). ind_recession_weeks — drainage e-folding time. fast well empties recharge stops, .e. storage/transmissivity ratio. well can long memory short recession (large storage, drains freely starts), long response short memory (deep water table, flashy water arrives). Divergence three informative, contradiction.
